title: Deprecated method
detail: The `should_ignore_error` method is deprecated and will be removed in Flask 3.3. Handle errors as needed in teardown handlers instead.

title: Missing timeout
detail: The `entry_points` function is called without a timeout, which can lead to a blocking call if the plugin takes a long time to load.
note: Near the bug, but entry_points() takes no timeout.

title: Missing timeout handling
detail: The `_cancel_keeps_body` property does not handle timeouts correctly. It should return `True` if the stream is cancelled and `fail_on_dataloss` is False, and the response status is not None.
note: The property is right as written.

title: Empty spans check
detail: The code now checks if `spans` is empty before attempting to access its last element, which prevents an infinite loop when the input text is empty.
note: Describes what the PR does, not a problem.

title: Empty last_measured_character check
detail: The code now checks if `last_measured_character` is not None before accessing its `narrow_to_wide` attribute, which prevents an infinite loop when the input text is empty.
note: Describes what the PR does, not a problem.
